series.name: Us
series.original_name: Us รักของเรา
series.overview: Eighteen-year-old Dokrak decides to take a gap year to find herself after finishing high school. She has a part-time job at a coworking space coffee shop, Cuf & Co. It's here that she crosses paths with twenty-two-year-old dentistry student Pam who 's a regular at the café to hit the books. As she gets to know Pam, Dokrak develops a crush. When her brother, however, meets Pam, he falls for her at first sight. Kawi turns to Dokrak, asking her to play matchmaker. Because she loves him and wants to see him happy, Dokrak begins coaching him. As time goes on, however, she finds herself unable to ignore her growing feelings for Pam. Before she knows it, she's fully in love and Pam is Kawi's girlfriend.

series.name: Stepmother

series.name: Good Heavens! I'm a Goose Not a Swan

series.name: House of Flames

As the family's wealth grows, so do rivalry and power struggles, leading to a mysterious fire and deaths. Amid the chaos, only one person knows the truth. His journey is fraught with danger—not just from those seeking the relic but also from his entanglement with a secret resistance. At its heart is Sarika, a woman of mysterious origins who stirs something deep within him.

series.name: Club Friday Theory of Love: Friends with Benefits (No Strings Attached)
series.original_name: คลับฟรายเดย์เดอะซีรีส์ Theory of Love ไม่มีทฤษฎีไหนใช้ได้กับทุกความรัก ตอน FWB ห้ามรัก ห้ามรู้สึก
series.overview:
He is a young man scarred by repeated heartbreak, vowing never to let his heart suffer again. To shield himself, he fills his days with fleeting pleasures, moving from one partner to the next. That is, until he meets her, a woman who begins as a one-night stand but evolves into his Friend with Benefits thanks to their compatibility in bed.

Both are careful to keep their personal live hidden, reveling only selected fragments of their stories. They know the rule of this arrangement: never cross the line, never make it personal. What happens when he decides to pursue something deeper, but she keeps him at arm's length? He learns the hard way that even a relationship meant to be free of emotion, like Friends with Benefits, can leave the heart broken in the most painful of ways.

(Source: Change2561)

series.name: My Undying Miracle
series.original_name: รักจะตาย My Miracle

Her life changes when she meets Makkhawat, a kind-hearted blogger who views her as a workaholic and difficult to approach. Everything shifts when Neeracha is diagnosed with breast cancer. She hides her illness and battles it alone until she finally confronts the truth. Through treatment, she learns the value of sacrifice, forgiveness, and self-care, strengthening her family bonds, with Makkhawat by her side.

Sang Thong is a charming talker, Mai Phlong is quick-witted but not very bright, and Thong Bai is an inventor whose creations resemble things from 2025. Despite being close friends, they all fall for Jolie, a foreign missionary teaching English to Khun Phra Bamroekrung's children. When the groom is found shot dead at Khun Phra Bamroekrung's wedding, the three are suspected of murder. Faced with overwhelming evidence against them, they must escape and uncover the true killer.

series.name: Reset to Remember
series.original_name: เริ่มใหม่ให้ใจจำ
series.overview:
Pure, the owner of a floating resort, stumbles upon an unconscious young woman on the roadside. Pure names her MaMa and offers her a temporary place to stay, with the hope that she will eventually recall her past.

Their bond slowly deepens amidst the peace and simplicity of nature and a simple life. As MaMa's memories begin to return, she discovers a truth that could alter everything. What path will she choose when she is torn between the past and her feelings for Pure?

series.name: My Golden Blood
series.original_name: เลือดนายลมหายใจฉัน
series.overview: Mark is a vampire who hasn't found the meaning of life in centuries until he meets Tong, who gives him a reason to live. However, Tong's rare and powerful blood is irresistible to vampires, and Mark not only has to protect Tong from other vampires, he also has to fight his inner desire, struggling between love and instinct.

series.name: The Destiny, Love and Fate
series.original_name: ละอองเทศ
series.overview: The story follows Dolly, a resilient young woman who lost her mother, and Krin, a handsome businessman and heir to a major sauce company.

series.name: Club Friday Theory of Love: The Gift of Love
series.original_name: คลับฟรายเดย์เดอะซีรีส์ Theory of Love ไม่มีทฤษฎีไหนใช้ได้กับทุกความรัก ตอน ความรักคือการให้
series.overview:
She is a kind-hearted woman, a textbook People Pleaser who firmly believes that loving someone means giving without expecting anything in return. He is a seemingly ordinary man who holds a special place in her heart. She supports every aspect of his life, heling him grow and succeed. Over time, this ordinary man transforms into someone extraordinary with an impressive profile and endless opportunities ahead.

However, as he ascends to a new level of success, he begins to distance himself from her, convinced that she is no longer the right person to stand beside him. Despite his attempts to pull away, she clings tighter, giving more and more of herself in a desperate effort to keep him close.

(Source: Change2561)

series.name: My Mother's Recipe
series.original_name: ชะตาหงส์
series.overview: A food stylist returns to her grandfather's home after learning that a hidden will may prove her mother's claim to a family inheritance. As she searches for the truth, she faces resistance from a rival family member and unexpected complications involving romance.

series.name: Reclaim
series.original_name: ทวง
series.overview: Nilin is a woman whose life was shattered after being sexually assaulted and left for dead. But when she returns, she is no longer a victim. She reinvents herself as Phrae, a woman determined to take revenge on those who destroyed her, using every means necessary to bring justice to herself.

series.name: I'm Your Moon
series.original_name: กัษธิษฐาน
series.overview: Pray, the noble heir of Ussanakorn Palace, falls in love with Earl of Sitalaras Palace — a graceful and perfect lady. However, their love is impossible, for a deep-seated grudge exists between Ussanakorn Palace and Sitalaras Palace, making it impossible for them to be together. Pray suffers greatly, tormented by the true love that yearns for fulfillment. Until fate gives them a second chance — Pray and the Earl are reborn. Will the two of them be able to join hands and prove their true love at last?

series.name: Crush on You

series.name: Ghost Of Love
series.original_name: พิศวาสข้ามภพ
series.overview:
This is the story of Wang Takian village, where a beautiful woman called Praethong once eloped with her lover Muen Khiri, after being forced to marry Phloeng. However, they were chased and caught by Praethong, who in his rage killed Meun Khiri. Having witnessed the death of her lover, Praethong committed suicide. The two dead lovers were buried together under a Takian tree.

Hundreds of years passed, however, Praethong could not enter the rebirth cycle due to committing suicide. Instead, she became the mother of Wangtakhian, an entity revered by the villagers. All she could do now was wait to meet her lover Muen Khiri again.

series.name: Until the Sun Meets the Star
series.original_name: เมื่อตะวันลับฟ้า ก็จะเป็นเวลาของดวงดาว
series.overview: A childhood accident unknowingly ties Napdao to Khimhan, the son of the man who destroyed her family. Years later, they meet again, unaware of their past connection, and become entangled in a love triangle and a dangerous web of revenge when Napdao’s long-lost mother returns after 20 years in prison.

series.name: Catch Cat Crush
series.original_name: รักไม่บอก...เหมียวบอกให้
series.overview:
Smay(Puifai) returns to their old home in search of the new owner of their parents' house, hoping to buy it back. However, this return leads Smay to reunite with Thian (Ferin)the elegant yet aloof neighbor from their childhood.

Despite Smay's cheerful and affectionate attempts to win her over, Thian responds with indifference and a hint of annoyance. Meanwhile, "MomMam," Thian's mischievous cat, keeps a close watch on every moment.

Amidst a whirlwind of love, hidden truths, and unresolved pasts, Smay and Thian must confront their feelings and their history. How will their hearts find their way? Stay tuned to find out soon!

series.name: Homeroom

series.name: Game of Succession

series.name: Now It’s My Turn
series.original_name: ถึงตาฉัน รักเธอบ้าง
series.overview:
Fight (Meen), a confident soon to be CEO, once spent 3 years pursuing Napdao (Amee), who was scared of everything. Until one day Fight is exhausted and decides to stop loving. But when Fight retreats, Napdao realizes too late how deeply her heart is tied to her.

The problem is... Fight is no longer where she used to be.

From who used to run away, Napdao became who ran after to chase in the game of feelings, the roles have completely changed.

In this upside down love story, how will this love end? Will Napdao be able to love with all her heart and win back the one she let go?

series.name: Bump in Destiny
series.original_name: รักคอนเฟิร์ม เสปิร์มท่านประทาน
series.overview: Innocent and sweet Prang is accidentally inseminated with the assertive CEO Kawin's sperm during her medical examination, leading to pregnancy. Thus, the fate of the two is intertwined. In the process of getting along with each other, Kawin helps Prang step out of the shadow of their original family, and the two eventually fall in love. Also, the truth behind the unexpected pregnancy is revealed.

Over time, their relationship filled with teasing and jokes transforms into a warm love due to the peaceful nature and collaborative work.

Can Cin show that she's not just a young lady? Is it possible for Grean to open her heart to someone as annoying as Sin?

Now, the dreams have returned, and she begins looking into the legend of Phadaeng Nang Ai, meeting Korawit who looks strikingly like a man she knows only from her dreams. When a news of a Naga sighting at Phadaeng Nang Ai reaches him, Korawit decides to investigate. As Airada begins questioning her connection to the past, a joint journey to uncover the truth and break the city's ancient curse begins.

series.overview: A successful businessman returns to sell an old building and unexpectedly reunites with his former lover. As they navigate shared memories and unresolved emotions, the past slowly begins to surface — and so does the possibility of a second chance.

series.name: Khemjira
series.original_name: เขมจิราต้องรอด
series.overview: With a deadly curse set to claim him at 21, a young man flees to a master of ancient magic—only to face ghosts more dangerous than his fate.

series.name: Never Ending
series.original_name: รัก ไม่ เลิก
series.overview: Namtan, Dr. Taengkwa, and Oat are a hotline team members and close friends. They offer mental health support, yet each is barely surviving the love storm raining down day after day, taking them to the brink of emotional collapse.

series.name: Rearrange
series.original_name: ขอฟังอีกครั้งเพลงรักของเธอ
series.overview: Win gets a second chance to relive the past and chase the dreams he once shared with Nut. But as he tries to change fate, will he save their love—or lose it again?

series.name: Roller Coaster
series.original_name: รักขบวนนี้หัวใจเกือบวาย
series.overview: Living a carefree life has begun to take its toll. Jumping into a rollercoaster of a relationship is giving these thrill seekers a taste of feelings beyond joy.

series.name: Queendom
series.original_name: ซ่อนใจไว้ที่เธอ
series.overview: Enemies since school up to entering the entertainment industry, Rey and Print meet again when they land roles in a highly anticipated series. One week before filming's to begin, however, something strange happens: their souls switch bodies. Chaos ensues. Most importantly, though, their feelings towards one another begin to shift as they embody one another.

series.name: Based on 2 Stories
series.original_name: Based on 2 Stories
series.overview: Actors from two different projects are invited to come together and talk about their roles both on and off screen.

series.name: The Other Me
series.original_name: อีกคนในใจเธอ
series.overview:
In a small cafe, under the warm afternoon light, two women accidentally meet—a woman whose heart is sealed by a secret from the past, and another who hides her feelings behind a seemingly innocent smile.

Every conversation…every glance…slowly opens the door to an unintended connection. But the deeper they go, the more dangerous it becomes, as a certain truth could change everything forever.

series.name: The Luminous Begins
series.original_name: แสงแรกรัก
series.overview: Return to the origin of the enchanted wish… The source of joy received from the cursed coffee shop.

series.name: The Mask of Love
series.original_name: ผีตาโขน
series.overview:
Uncle Boon is an elder craftsman of ghost masks, which are said to be vessels for the dead. After dreaming of his missing daughter, Lalita, calling for help in the forest, he's unaware when her spirit enters his latest piece.

When travel content creator Thianphisut visits the Phi Ta Khon ghost festival in Loei with her boyfriend Rachen, she purchases Uncle Boon's blue mask and is possessed by Lalita's spirit. In this new form, Lalita meets her former lover Chatban, and he feels an uncanny familiarity.

series.name: The Successor
series.original_name: ทายาทหมายเลข 1
series.overview: Family patriarch Phanu wants his mall to be on top and his children will have to make it happen. Eldest son Nathee and his wife Wirin believe the younger generation, coming in with fresh ideas, should lead the business. When Nathee and his eldest son die in a tragic helicopter crash, Wirin is heartbroken. Soon, however, she's shocked to be accused of their murder and her second son, a monk named Talayluang, is forced to leave the monkhood to help her. A battle between Talayluang and Mahasamut, another of Phanu's grandsons, is about to begin.

series.name: Eyes of Heaven
series.original_name: ดวงตาสวรรค์
series.overview: In World War II Bangkok, a servant-turned-actress lets envy consume her as she schemes against a noble family’s daughter and risks everything to win the man she loves.

series.name: I Love Me a Medium
series.original_name: ยัยปลาไหลกับนายไฮโซ
series.overview: In a rural village, Fahmui leads the fight against outsider Sattaya’s land grab, earning the villagers’ trust with her wit and claims of divine guidance, only for Sattaya’s suspicion of her to gradually blossom into love.

series.name: Flame Book
series.original_name: แฟนผมคนนี้ดีกรี 4.00
series.overview: Top academic champion Book lives a disciplined and rational life, excelling in every subject with precision. In contrast, Frame—one of the most popular students on campus—avoids studying and spends his time dating different girls. With completely opposite personalities, their worlds collide when a teacher assigns them to a tutoring program. When Frame teasingly asks, “Want me to teach you about love?”, what began as an unlikely pairing starts to spiral beyond expectations.

series.name: Prime Tour
series.original_name: บัดดี้ทำดีดี...นี่เพื่อนซี้แกเอง
series.overview: Tour is the most popular boy at his all-boys school, effortlessly drawing attention wherever he goes. Yet the person he cares about most is Prime—his childhood friend and gaming partner. Though they share a close bond, their relationship has always stayed within the line of “just friends.” But when a playful request for a kiss turns into something more, the unspoken tension between them begins to shift. Perhaps this time, they won’t be able to remain just friends.

series.name: Revamp: The Undead Story
series.original_name: สัญญารักแห่งแวมไพร์ ผนึกหัวใจ... ชั่วนิรันดร์
series.overview: After his blood frees a century-old vampire trapped in a painting, an antique dealer must help him regain his powers before deadly Hunters close in.

series.name: The Sandy Effect
series.original_name: แซนดี้ ครูแสนดี
series.overview: Volunteer teacher Sandy believes in the message "no child left behind." She makes it her mission to help her underprivileged young students discover their potential and make sure they don't fall out of the system.

series.name: Max Vote Road Trip
series.original_name: MAX VOTE ROAD TRIP ทริปดีจริง วิ่งเต็ม MAX BY NEW ISUZU D-MAX
series.overview:
Six celebrities take a road trip with activities determined entirely by votes.

MAX VOTE ROAD TRIP: A Great Trip, Full Max Speed, by the New ISUZU D-MAX

series.name: MuTeLuv
series.original_name: โปรดใช้วิจารณญาณในการรักเธอ
series.overview: This anthology tells seven stories of people who attempt to use supernatural forces to meet their goals, and their unique journeys to finding love along the way.

series.name: Bites of Promise
series.original_name: ไบท์ออฟพรอมิส
series.overview: The story of two close friends, with bitterness hidden in every promise... yet a sweetness remains that makes the heart tremble with every memory.

series.name: Golden Feathers
series.original_name: ใครกันแน่ที่แพ้เกมนี้
series.overview: In Golden Feather Academy, stepsiblings Tanya and Leo rule as icons of beauty and power. When Tanya’s pride is wounded by the cold new Student Council President, Logic, she wagers with her playboy stepbrother: seduce him within a month, or forfeit her dominance. But as Leo dives into the dangerous game, Tanya discovers the true cost of her revenge—losing the one man who has always belonged to her.

series.name: The Thirsty Thirty
series.original_name: 30 เพิ่งเริ่มต้น
series.overview: Follow three Piscean women in their thirties whose intertwined lives navigate dreams, desires, and ambition in an intense Thai drama, where luxury masks hidden cracks and secrets

series.name: Heart Rule
series.original_name: กฎของหัวใจ
series.overview: Nabao is the daughter of "Khun Phop", the owner of a famous business. Because Khun Phop's business now has competitors who want to harm him, Khun Phop, who is worried about Nabdao, fears danger, sends a skilled female bodyguard, "Chris", to take care of her. When the two of them are together, many things happen, including their feelings that start to form. But the love between the young lady and the bodyguard is not that easy when a neighbor, "Nicha", comes in to mess with their relationship.

series.name: Hidden Heal
series.original_name: Hidden Heal
series.overview:
After the truth is revealed, Farm and Frame(both Ferin) must confront the deep scars within their sisterhood.

Learning to forgive and truly understand each other becomes the most important journey of their hearts. With Gale(Puifai) and Prim (Great) by their side, love becomes the strength that helps them heal.

Hidden Heal - a story of healing that proves "love" not only mends wounds, but makes us stronger

series.name: More Than Idol
series.original_name: More Than Idol
series.overview: A reality show searching for a 'TG Girl' with the concept '7 Girls, 7 Days, 7 Nights' to find someone who is 'more than an idol' and a connection that lies within friendship and closeness.

series.name: Shuffle of Hearts
series.original_name: พรหมพยศ
series.overview: After falling for the man who once saved her life, Paengram hides her feelings when he begins pursuing her older sister. Choosing loyalty over love, Paengram tries to help them be together. As family scandals, betrayals, and danger unfold, Paengram must navigate heartbreak and protect those she loves.

series.name: My Sassy Wedding
series.original_name: เจ้าคุณพี่กับอีนางคำดวง
series.overview: When Khamduang, a humble village girl, agrees to pose as the wife of Khun Ek, a noble officer trying to escape political schemes, they’re thrust into a world of deception, danger, and forbidden desire - where survival may depend on love.

series.name: The Seer
series.original_name: ตัวแทน
series.overview: A mysterious man who calls himself a fortune teller claims to possess a special gift — the ability to read destinies and serve as a medium for the dead. Acting as a “spiritual substitute,” he brings departed souls back to those they left behind, giving the living a final chance to uncover truths that were never spoken before death.

series.name: Task (2025) ภารกิจชีวิต
series.original_name: Task (2025) ภารกิจชีวิต

series.name: The Dark Dice
series.original_name: เกมทอยทะลุมิติ
series.overview: When a mysterious dice game puts lives on the line, players must fight, betray, and survive—or lose everything.

series.name: Mandate
series.original_name: คมเดือน
series.overview: A devoted doctor shuns politics until a crisis draws him to a party, unaware its ambitious leader hides a secret that will upend his life forever.

series.name: Love in the Moonlight
series.original_name: สลักรักในแสงจันทร์
series.overview: In 1963 Bangkok, a prince sent for an arranged marriage finds his heart drawn instead to his fiancée’s cousin, forcing him to choose between love and duty.

series.name: Songkhram Molam
series.original_name: สงครามหมอลำ
series.overview: When a morlam queen clashes with a rising star, two rival troupes battle for the spotlight and each other’s hearts in a fiery musical showdown.

series.name: First Love
series.original_name: คนแรกของใจ
series.overview: Gunya has a reputation for going through girlfriends quickly. She ends up hiring Jenny as her secretary, but does she have something else in mind?

series.name: 4 Destiny Project
series.original_name: 4 Destiny
series.overview: A collection of four BL series, directed by four visionary directors- get ready for an emotional roller coaster.

series.name: The Last Night
series.original_name: คืนสุดท้าย
series.overview: A bond between life and death turns into love. After a tragic accident, a spirit and a living person cross paths in haunting ways.

series.name: My Superstar, My Love
series.original_name: แผนรักร้ายของนายซุปตาร์
series.overview: Patt, a hardworking motorbike taxi driver focused solely on supporting his younger brother, never expected to cross paths with Leon, a glamorous superstar. When Leon dramatically pulls Patt into the spotlight during a heated public confrontation, Patt finds himself thrust into a chaotic new world. Reluctantly accepting a job as Leon’s assistant, Patt navigates the demands of a difficult boss, maintaining a complicated public façade, and living under the same roof as his new employer.

series.name: That Summer
series.original_name: ผมเจอเจ้าชายบนชายหาด
series.overview: Sent to a remote island for discipline, a troublemaker meets an amnesiac castaway whose presence turns his dull summer into love.

series.name: Poisonous Love
series.original_name: พิษรัก
series.overview: Dr. Prem, a flawless heart surgeon, faces chaos when her wedding is ruined by actress Pat. What begins as resentment soon turns into unexpected attraction after a fateful kiss reveals deeper feelings between them.

series.name: Rak OVERDOSE
series.original_name: รัก OVERDOSE
series.overview: Two women fight societal judgment, family rejection, and addiction, proving that love can be both their greatest strength and deepest challenge.

series.name: The Girl who Meow
series.original_name: แมวที่มากับฝน คนที่มากับรัก
series.overview:
On a rainy night, Rain(Aize), the quiet cafe owner who has long locked away her heart, encounters Punpang(Bella), a lively intern seeking shelter from the storm. With her playful, cat-like charm, Punpang gradually fills the empty cafe with warmth so much so that Rain can't help but wonder if she might be the "lost cat" returning in human form.

But when P'Yok, suddenly reappears, their budding relationship is shaken. This new love becomes tangled in shyness, jealousy, and the lingering question

Who will truly claim that seat the possessive little cat, or the lover who has come back

series.name: Lover Merman
series.original_name: เพียงนาวา (Phiang Nawa)
series.overview: A newcomer to an island bar falls for its star bartender, unaware he’s secretly a merman, while a protective friend warns that love between a human and a merman spells trouble.

series.name: Lover Merman
series.original_name: เพียงนาวา
series.overview: A newcomer to an island bar falls for its star bartender, unaware he’s a merman—while a protective friend warns that love between human and merman spells tragedy.

series.name: The Wicked Game
series.original_name: เกม รัก ลวง
series.overview: An abandoned heir wages war to expose his ruthless father and seize control of the family empire, but treachery—and desire—threaten his plan.

series.name: How to Suffer 101
series.original_name: วิชาทุก(ข์)พื้นฐาน
series.overview: A former psychotherapist takes on a Happiness class full of troubled students, and must prove whether true happiness can really be taught.

series.name: Loser Dream
series.original_name: ผม เขา เรา ปริศนา
series.overview: Ai, haunted by nightmares of a past murder, turns to lucid dreaming for answers. There, he meets In, a mysterious man who feels all too real. But when his charming boss Jin enters the picture, Ai finds himself torn between dream and reality—where love and danger blur.

series.name: The Beginning of Love
series.original_name: เพราะพรหมลิขิต

series.name: Love Design
series.original_name: รับ(รัก)ออกแบบ
series.overview: Two former lovers turned rival architects clash professionally after a betrayal involving stolen work. Their competitive relationship grows more complex when a new romantic interest emerges.

series.name: Red Moon and Wine
series.original_name: คืนจันทร์เลือด
series.overview: When a man enters a cursed hotel tied to a vow beneath the red moon, vengeance, immortality, and love intertwine in a battle against destiny.

series.name: Player
series.original_name: Player ไม่อาจห้ามรัก
series.overview: "Pun" A young woman who ventured to America hoping to settle there, hired a man for a marriage contract but was betrayed when he fled with her 1 million baht payment. Now pursued by mysterious mafia groups, she's forced to return to Thailand and hunt down her betrayer for answers. Pun has to extract intel from "Ploy" The gorgeous villain actress of Thai entertainment, who happens to be the betrayer's sister. Hoping proximity will make "Ploy" reveal her brother's secrets, a mission of seduction and heartbreak begins. But the more "Pun" deceives to make her fall in love, the deeper she falls herself. The more traps she sets, the more she gets caught.

series.name: Love Moment
series.original_name: บทรัก
series.overview: "Love Moment" Thai Girl Love Reality with 8 female contestants who all have dreams in acting and have to live in the same house with various roles. This will allow viewers to experience the thrill of friendship, intimacy, and discover the meaning of the word "love" together.

series.name: A(ir) Moment
series.original_name: โอกาส อากาศ
series.overview: After humanity destroys the world, four men wake up in a barren, forgotten land with no memories or technology. As they struggle to survive, tangled emotions—love, jealousy, and longing—emerge. In a world stripped of meaning, will they find hope or fall together?

series.name: Dangerous Queen
series.original_name: คนโปรดของควีน
series.overview:
Bonita spends her time supporting her mother who suffers from alcohol and gambling addiction. In addition to this, her neighbour "Kem" pursues her relentlessly even though she only sees him as a friend.

Her life takes a surprising turn when she goes to a bar and meets "Queen", a high-society woman from a prominent family. Queen helps Bonita escape her mother's abuse and they face various challenges before they become each other's favourite.

"In my life, I have only one favourite person."

series.name: Doctor Love Edition
series.original_name: รักนี้เวอร์ชั่นคุณหมอ
series.overview: Celine, a famous actress, has been experiencing nightmares for over 5 years. She has sought treatment in many places without success, until she met a new therapist named Pim. Celine was immediately drawn to Pim's personality, which was unlike anyone else she had met. Meeting Pim also led her to Pat, Pim's real brother, who knew certain secrets about her and was the cause of Celine's nightmares.

series.name: Lying
series.original_name: ลวง
series.overview: On a quest for vengeance, a young woman infiltrates a wealthy real estate family, plotting to destroy them as their wary matriarch grows suspicious.

series.name: The Cursed Love
series.original_name: รัก สาป สูญ
series.overview: With his fire powers out of control, a billionaire model teams up with a cynical rescue officer on a dangerous quest to cure his curse in a lost city.

series.name: Toxic Mansion
series.original_name: ท็อกซิก แมนชั่น : เคหาสน์วิปลาส
series.overview:
Welcome to TOXIC MANSION — the most dramatic reality show ever built in The Sims 4!

In this luxurious mansion, a group of contestants must live together under one roof.

But behind the glamour hides jealousy, secrets, and unstoppable drama!

series.name: Unlimited Love
series.original_name: บริษัทนี้ไม่มีจำกัด
series.overview: When office worker Plu is fired from her job after hitting a leering senior, she's left in state of distress as she has her mother and younger sibling to take care of. In low spirits, she meets Ray, a beautiful and wealthy-looking woman who proposes she opens a company called Unlimited Company, a company that will do absolutely anything as long as clients have the money to pay them. Her family owns a building available for rent, and she'd be happy to be a partner.  Whether it's the beauty of the woman before her or her drunkenness that persuades her, Plu doesn't know, but she's soon opening up applications for employees with unpredictable talents. Soon, the office is filled with beautiful people, chaos and headache-inducing challenges. What starts as a mess of confusion gradually becomes a second home as relationships between coworkers begin blossoming into something beyond work.  (Source: Thai = Miss Grand International || Translation: MDL

series.name: Until Once Again
series.original_name: ...จนกว่ารักจะหวนคืน...
series.overview:
After a heated argument on the way home, Peach(Ferin) and Miuu(Puifai) are forced to spend the night at a remote forest resort. But when they wake up, they realize they're stuck in the same day, looping over and over again. As they try everything to escape the loop, they soon discover that the hardest part isn't breaking free from time. It's confronting the unspoken feelings between them.

In a day that keeps repeating... is there a chance they might fall in love again?

series.name: Bitter Honeymoon
series.original_name: น้ำผึ้งขม
series.overview: After being betrayed by his first love Rose, Purin schemes revenge by marrying her daughter Kangsadan, but as he grows close to her, unexpected feelings of love and warmth emerge, complicating his plan and testing their path forward.

series.name: The Love Never Sets
series.original_name: ฉากนั้น…ยังเป็นเธอ
series.overview: After surviving trauma and leaving school, Ice returns to confront his past—only to be cast in an intimate film with the boy he never forgave.

series.name: Un-in Heart
series.original_name: หัวใจหรัญญ์
series.overview: A singer’s past returns when his ex resurfaces. The heart must reckon with old wounds and new feelings.

series.name: Me and Who
series.original_name: โปตัวปลอม
series.overview: After waking up in a billionaire heir’s body, a broke man’s secret unravels when his mind-reading fiancé discovers the truth on their first date.

series.name: Sweet Dreams
series.original_name: ฆ่าฉันในฝันของนาย
series.overview: A thriller film directed by Tai, becomes a horrifying reality when murders mirror its scenes. With a detective, a psychiatrist, and the haunting return of his ex, he must uncover the true killer before it’s too late.

series.name: The Hater
series.original_name: The Hater
series.overview: ”Phapwat“ a rising star painter who is about to showcase her work in a prestigious gallery, sees her life turned upside down when old scandals and fabricated rumors surface on the internet. Driven by rage, she decides to transform from a ”painter“ into a ”killer,“ while a determined female police officer ”Phanwa“ relentlessly follows her every move.

series.name: My Secret of Seer
series.original_name: การโต้กลับของซินแส
series.overview: Cursed by bad luck at 25 and a supernatural sense of smell, a young seer must team up with a charismatic ghost show host to survive a year of curses.

series.name: Operation Seduction
series.original_name: ปฏิบัติการยั่วรัก
series.overview: When a CEO, tired of his younger brother’s chaos, sends his most trusted man to keep him in line, what begins as a game of teasing soon turns into a dangerous attraction between guardian and ward.

series.name: Mystique in the Mirror
series.original_name: ใครในกระจก
series.overview: Alan is trying to find the answers to who he was in the past and who he is now, every time he looks in the mirror, an old man appears. One day he meets Darwin, a young man who seems to be in the room next to Alan’s in the mental health hospital. He’s liked Alan since their first meeting.

series.name: My Safe Zone
series.original_name: รักสุดท้าย
series.overview: Alin leaves her best friend Jane to study abroad. Years later, a broken engagement brings her home, where they face feelings long unspoken.

series.name: The Love of Addiction
series.original_name: เสพติดรักนักเดิมพัน
series.overview: Arlo, a charming art teacher by day and reckless gambler by night, falls under the patronage of Zane to pay off his debts. Their sugar arrangement sparks a double life—daytime campus romance, nighttime domination of the gambling world. What begins as a transaction grows into real love and mutual redemption.

series.name: Under the Moonlight
series.original_name: รักใต้แสงจันทร์
series.overview: Phat, a young aristocrat from Bangkok, is sent north on a political mission but, after a mysterious lunar eclipse, awakens in the present day. There, he meets Namping, a free-spirited musician deeply rooted in Lanna culture. Between two worlds and under the gentle sound of the salo, Phat embarks on a journey of newfound freedom and feelings he never knew existed in his time.

series.name: Head 2 Head
series.original_name: ไหนใครว่าพวกมันไม่ถูกกัน
series.overview: A rivalry turns upside down when Jerome’s strange new ability shows him a shocking future—one where his enemy becomes his soulmate.

series.name: ClaireBell
series.original_name: คลั่ง/รัก/นักโทษ
series.overview: Fate led Bell, an unfortunate young woman, into prison, where she had to struggle for survival alone, without hope. That was until Claire, a mysterious female inmate, appeared to help her. And from that moment on... the encounter between these two souls began to fill this dark and desolate place with a small glimmer of light, one that gradually grew into love.

series.name: Kiss Of Yesterday
series.original_name: รอยจูบของวันวาน

series.name: Mission: Love or Lies
series.original_name: ภารกิจลวงรัก
series.overview:
Achi, a smart female police captain, is assigned to protect Patty, the daughter of a powerful politician recently targeted in an attack. To stay safe, Patty secretly swaps places with her bodyguard Alice in order to keep the mission under wraps.

As Achi works to keep Patty safe, she starts to feel something more than just duty. Love begins to grow—slowly, quietly—in the middle of danger. But strange things begin to happen, and Patty and Alice are both hiding something.

series.name: Blood Fighters
series.original_name: สัง เวียน ที่รัก
series.overview: A gritty world of boxing and survival becomes the arena for love and destiny.

series.name: Goddess Bless You from Death
series.original_name: สิงสาลาตาย
series.overview: A gifted young man and a rational detective investigate brutal forest murders, uncovering ancient beliefs and dangers that defy all logic.

series.name: Rock and Soul
series.original_name: จังหวะร็อกปาฏิหาริย์รัก
series.overview: After a near-fatal accident puts Alice in a coma, Pun and his bandmates embark on a series of supernatural missions to restore her soul. Along the way, they pursue their shared passion for music, hoping to reunite Alice with the band Rock and Soul.

series.name: Zomvivor
series.original_name: มหาลัยคลั่ง
series.overview: When an apocalyptic virus that turns people into zombies ravages a city, a group of students take shelter in a school and fight to survive.

series.name: Wash & Wait
series.original_name: #รักนี้รอได้
series.overview: Belle and Fang are strangers who happen to frequent the same laundromat almost every week. Each time, hilarious and chaotic situations arise, forcing them to talk and turning coincidences into intentional encounters.

series.name: Decalcomania
series.original_name: ทวิญ ร่างฉัน วิญญาณเธอ
series.overview: Two identical women from completely different worlds switch bodies after a mysterious accident. Nuengdiao, a Bangkok nightclub owner with a dark past, and Lea, a wealthy Singaporean heiress, must survive in each other’s lives—facing hidden secrets, high-society intrigues, and the dangers of the underground world.

series.name: Spoiled by My Mafia Boss
series.original_name: พันธนาการรักซ่อนหนาม
series.overview: A traumatized young man raised as a political pawn finds unexpected solace in someone who offers him real love, but when he learns his adoptive father murdered his real family, he sets out on a path of vengeance that collides with his chance at healing.

series.name: Friendshit Forever
series.original_name: เพื่อนสนิท พิษสหาย
series.overview: An outcast and a wealthy student become fast friends, but the secrets they keep might prove more dangerous than either could have suspected.

series.name: Ice Break, Heart Melt
series.original_name: ละลายรัก ยัยน้ำแข็ง
series.overview:
When Neve (Namo), a cold-hearted figure skater, is forced into a fake dating project with Ivy(Amee), a sharp-tongued heiress, neither expects the scripted romance to stir something real. What begins as a business arrangement slowly melts into something warmer laughter, sincerity, and a love they can't quite hide.

From a fake game of hearts to a love that melts the ice for real.

series.name: Runaway
series.original_name: หนีไปก็ตายเปล่า
series.overview: With only 168 hours left to live, Winrawi becomes the target of a vengeful spirit whose presence grows stronger by the second. Haunted by a chilling voice and pushed to despair, she seeks help from a cold, mysterious woman—the only one who might save her, but who cruelly turns her away. As time runs out, Winrawi must face the dark secrets of her past, uncovering a truth more terrifying than death itself.

series.name: Hypnotic
series.original_name: จิตสะกดแค้น
series.overview: Secrets hidden, wrong overlooked, resentment building. The subconscious is revealed. However, some truths perhaps best left buried are about to be exposed.

series.name: I don't remember the feeling
series.original_name: I don't remember the feeling
series.overview: After Pleng(Ferin) and Grace(Puifai) through trials of the heart and found their way back to love, a mysterious accident steals not only Pleng's memories but also the feelings she once held. All that remains is a heart that still trembles whenever Grace is near. With pain, patience, and love, Grace must gently lead Pleng back to what they once had to prove that even when forgotten, true love endures.

series.name: TiWa RaTri
series.original_name: ทิวาราตรี
series.overview: All of this is the story of "Holy Water". A young woman who had never believed in black magic until one day her life became entangled in these things because her friend's boyfriend used some kind of way to hurt her, making her life unsettling as before. A white-belted fortune teller who knows about magic.

series.name: Club Friday The Series 17: ความดีชนะใจ
series.original_name: Club Friday The Series 17: ความดีชนะใจ

series.name: Interminable
series.original_name: อสงไขย
series.overview: After inheriting an old house, a student meets a ghost who reveals their tragic past life and the eternal fate that still binds them.

series.name: Merit Wins the Soul
series.original_name: ความดีชนะใจ
series.overview: When people do good, they deserve to receive good in return. But for some, doing good for bad people might only lead to emptiness in return. This is the story of a woman who has been in a long-term relationship. She takes care of him and looks after him, even though he’s been secretly involved with other women throughout their time together. When she finds out, he apologizes and asks for another chance to start fresh, and she forgives him every time. What she doesn’t realize is that in doing good to win the hearts of others, she has forgotten to do good for her own heart.

series.name: Searching for the Love You Forgot
series.original_name: ตามหารักที่เธอลืม
series.overview: A devoted young woman travels to Bangkok to find her long-lost, terminally ill father, only to clash with his protective son while uncovering shocking clues that her mother’s death may have been a murder hidden behind years of family secrets.

series.name: The Tastes Of Lives
series.original_name: เลือดใหม่หัวใจนักปรุง
series.overview: The story of Parichart, owner of a Thai cooking school, whose strong determination to pass down traditional recipes brings together people from different backgrounds with their own stories to meet at this school, including her only daughter Parichat and her grandson Pokpong, who shares his grandmother’s passion for cooking.

series.name: Me and Thee
series.original_name: มีสติหน่อยคุณธีร์
series.overview: An introverted photographer's life changes when a former mafia boss hires him for love advice, only to end up falling for him instead.

series.name: Sway
series.original_name: เพราะเธอใช่ไหม...ที่ทำให้ใจฉัน สั่น

series.name: A Sample Family
series.original_name: บ้านตัวอย่าง ครอบครัวตัวหลอก
series.overview: During a historic Bangkok flood, Tui secretly moves his family-Nok and their daughter Gib-into a luxury show house. As they fake a perfect life online for Gib's elite school dream, their lies begin to unravel.

series.name: Burnout Syndrome
series.original_name: ภาวะรักคนหมดไฟ
series.overview: After losing his dream job, a burned-out artist falls between two men—a charming IT guy and a reclusive tycoon who hires him to be his public face.

series.name: Marry a CEO
series.original_name: แฟนผมบังเอิญเป็นท่านประธาน
series.overview: When Gu Nian's family faces a financial crisis, his father and stepmother pressure him to marry the daughter of the Wang family. To sabotage the arranged marriage, Nian picks up a scruffy homeless man, Lin Xiao, from the streets and claims he is his boyfriend, causing chaos. Little do they know that Xiao is actually a rich heir who just returned from abroad, hiding his identity to investigate a family scandal, and that he is Nian's childhood friend he has a marriage pact with. Xiao cleans up and happily plays the role of his boyfriend, but Nian's family still constantly tries to humiliate him. Xiao handles it with ease, proving his worth. With Xiao's help, Nian uncovers the mastermind behind the illegal attacks on his family's business, Li Yan. As Nian gradually falls for Xiao, Xiao's true identity brings about a shocking twist...

series.name: Like a Palette
series.original_name: เจน(จะ)เป็นดาวสินกำ
series.overview: Jane is confused about whether P'Dai's feelings are just kindness or if it's something more special!? We'll have to wait and see just when Jane will realize she's being courted!

series.name: LOVE (X)
series.original_name: LOVE (X)
series.overview:
This is the a ground-breaking and uplifting dating reality show made in Thailand, where 12 single men and women live together in Koh Samui, cut off from the outside world, pursuing boundless love. Through competitive games, they win dates and survival supplies. In the end, they'll make the final choice about who they want to keep seeing after the show.

"X" stands for the unknown, crossing paths and infinite possibilities—find the "X" of your dreams together!

series.name: Reloved
series.original_name: เริ่มใหม่หัวใจเดิม
series.overview: A single dad balancing new fatherhood crosses paths with his long-lost ex, reigniting old feelings and uncovering the truth behind their broken past.

series.name: Beauty Reborn
series.original_name: แผนรักฉบับร้าย
series.overview: Fresh out of college, ambitious cosmetic scientist Sara battles family struggles, office politics and a love triangle while saving a failing beauty firm.

series.name: Let Me Into Your Heart
series.original_name: ขอเป็นพระเอกในหัวใจพระเอก
series.overview: When a “superstar” who is used to the spotlight must step into the artistic world behind the curtain of a charming “Likay leading actor.”

series.name: Club Friday Theory of Love: Love Takes Time
series.original_name: คลับฟรายเดย์เดอะซีรีส์ Theory of Love ไม่มีทฤษฎีไหนใช้ได้กับทุกความรัก ตอน รักใครต้องดูใจกันให้นาน
series.overview:
They began dating during their student years and, when they entered the workforce, they built a stable life together, ready to settle down. However, she still felt that the time they had spent together wasn't enough to change the status of being a girlfriend into that of a wife. Despite all the time they spent together where he was a wonderful partner to her, she had hardly ever had to do anything for him. Over time, their love started to fade, and all that was left was a habitual experience of having each other in their loves.

This became the best time for a third party to step into their relationship. The new woman who entered the man's life was an ordinary woman with nothing to compete with her. She chose to ignore her and believed she knew him well enough to trust that he would never cheat. Reality, however, was different. The man who had been in her life for so long had become someone she barely recognised.

(Source: Change2561)

series.name: Melody of Secrets
series.original_name: ความลับในบทเพลงที่บรรเลงไม่รู้จบ
series.overview: An amnesiac journalist and a criminologist must work together to solve a string of brutal murders, slowly uncovering dangerous secrets in their past.

series.name: Kiss Me with Unspoken Love
series.original_name: จูบไร้เสียง

series.name: Thorn of the Rose
series.original_name: กุหลาบซ่อนหนาม
series.overview:
After school bully Pitch secretly films high-school student Thorn and his gay lover Jett having sex, and makes the video public, Jett commits suicide due to public pressure and domestic violence. Thorn gets gender-affirming surgery and now goes by the name of Rose, infiltrating the lives of his enemies. Rose discovers that Pitch is a twisted coward who has a crush on Thorn, and his father-in-law Thanes is the one who killed Rose's parents. During her revenge, Rose witnesses her best friend Jennie being tortured and killed by Pitch's wife, Deenee, and Pitch dies while trying to save her.

Deenee then comes to her senses and kills her father, while Rose sets aside her hatred and is reborn under the guidance of Jett's ghost. Ultimately, this bloody revenge exposes the shady drug trafficking among the wealthy and ends the cycle of hatred for three generations.

series.name: Killer Heart
series.original_name: หัวใจนักฆ่า
series.overview: Surprise's family was attacked, resulting in the deaths of her parents. Her only remaining relative, an uncle, took over the family business. While Surprise was returning to her room, she was kidnapped by the attackers, who turned out to be Alan, someone she had once helped. Alan's boss then ordered her to kill Surprise. What will Alan decide?

series.name: MuTeLuv: Hello, Is This Luck?
series.original_name: MuTeLuv: Hello, Is This Luck?
series.overview: Sixth-year medical student Na is full of talent but no luck. She's always thought that with effort comes success, but events in her life have led her to the suspicion recently that, really, it all comes down to fortune. Most significantly, Na has fallen for Nine, a handsome and intelligent senior beyond her reach. In order to force a change of fortune, Na decides to switch to a lucky phone number. It's then that she meets Leemai and soon she's much more than noticed by her crush.

series.name: My Secretary
series.original_name: เลขาของฉัน

series.name: Thai Sweet
series.original_name: 泰甜啦
series.overview: This is a reality show that blends scripted romance with real-life travel, a sweet variety program centered around on-screen couples.

series.name: MuTeluv: Love Lock
series.original_name: MuTeluv: Love Lock
series.overview: After being dumped by his girlfriend May on their third anniversary, Phayu struggles to move on and begins seeing vivid visions of her whenever he tries to start a new relationship. Believing that his misfortune is connected to an Ema wishing plaque May once left in Japan, Phayu travels to Kawagoe to find and remove it. There, an unexpected accident brings him together with Satsuki, an unlucky Japanese woman who reluctantly becomes his guide. As they search for the mysterious plaque, Phayu must decide whether to remain trapped by his past or open his heart to a new beginning.

series.name: The Heart of Yiwha: Of Love & Vengeance
series.original_name: ยิหวาดาตัง
series.overview: Yiam gives up his dream of becoming a doctor to pursue dark magic and seek revenge. Along the way, he meets Yiwha, a woman bound by a prophecy to bring tragedy to her family, and together they navigate a dangerous world shaped by fate, magic, and vengeance.

series.name: Missing
series.original_name: Missing ห่วง หาย ตาย จาก
series.overview: An intense series about an investigation where it’s not just about death, but the 'lingering care' that refuses to 'leave' until the mystery behind the death is solved.

series.name: My Boss, My Love, My Stepbrother！
series.original_name: แฟนและพี่ชาย ดันกลายเป็นบอส!
series.overview: Pete’s worst mistake becomes even messier when he realizes the man he accidentally slept with is his new stepbrother—and now also his strict internship supervisor.

series.name: Necromancer
series.original_name: จอมขมังเวทย์ Begins
series.overview: Growing up haunted by his father’s mysterious disappearance, Singha gains extraordinary powers from magical tattoos after a deadly incident. With the guidance of an occult master, he must harness his new abilities to confront a corrupt politician wielding dark magic and protect his city.

series.name: Cat for Cash
series.original_name: เปย์รักด้วยแมวเลี้ยง
series.overview: To pay his mother's debt, a cat-hater must work with a handsome feline lover, unaware that the man is the very person he owes money to.

series.name: Peach Lover
series.original_name: ลูกพีชทานสด
series.overview: A dedicated fan wins the chance to co-star with his favorite adult content creator, only for their work to turn into a real relationship.

series.name: The School
series.original_name: ศักดินาวิทยาลัย
series.overview: When a school becomes a battlefield, the clash between rich and poor students exposes deep inequalities and unearths secrets long kept in the shadows.

series.name: The Love in My Way
series.original_name: เสพติดรักนักเดิมพัน
series.overview:
Bing suffers psychological trauma from being bullied by classmates and called "promiscuous" by his first love, Max, during childhood. As an adult, Bing undergoes plastic surgery to become handsome and decides to take revenge on Max. At a bar, Bing encounters the classmates who bullied him and cleverly retaliates, during which he meets Max again. Max is attracted to Bing and helps him out of a tight spot.

Subsequently, Bing becomes entangled in complex emotional relationships with Max, New, and others, and gets involved in Au and Rod's drug dealing and spiking incidents. As Bing spends time with Max, his resolve for revenge wavers, and their relationship fluctuates between good and bad, filled with desire and conflict.

series.name: The Man Ruined My Hookup
series.original_name: นัดยิ้ม ล่มเพราะ นายตัวดี

series.name: The Earth
series.original_name: วิวาห์ปฐพี
series.overview:
'Rose' Thippapha Amornjinda, heir to the Chomjan acreage, returns to Chiang Rai from America when her stepfather falls into a coma following a suspicious accident. There, she finds herself in danger from Wasu, a vineyard owner who seeks to force her into marriage and snatch up her land for his illegal business operations. Fortunately, Rose's childhood friend and owner of an organic vegetable farm 'Din' Kasama Watinwanich comes to protect her. To secure her safety, she and Din will have to marry.

Even if it's only a sham marriage, their reestablished closeness gradually brings about real feelings.

series.name: Thee and Thee
series.original_name: ตั้งสติหน่อยคุณธีร์
series.overview: When 'Khun Thee' is sucked into the fictional world he wrote by AI, he finds himself turned into a side character, while 'Peach' becomes the protagonist. Khun Thee must race against the AI to fix the story, reclaim his memories, and choose the ending himself, before their love is overwritten forever!!!

series.name: Love Me, Love My Buffalo
series.original_name: เลดี้ทุ่งกระบือบาล
series.overview: A young district chief, Jomthap, defies his billionaire mother’s demands to inherit the family empire, choosing instead to serve a rural community. When an unintended marriage to Pichaya, a fierce village woman devoted to her land and buffaloes, entangles him further, he is drawn into a high-stakes battle over power, trust, and the village’s future.

series.name: Love Conceals Its Blade
series.original_name: รักซ่อนมีด
series.overview: Chanon, a medical intern driven by a three‑year vendetta, infiltrates the world of Leo Thanakorn, heir to a powerful mafia family, drawing him in with a meticulously planned seduction. The closer he gets, the more dangerous things become. He pushes the game to its limits, even taking a knife meant for Leo and gaining Leo’s possessive protection. He uses Leo’s trust to hunt down every enemy, counting down to the final target and to all illusions shattering.

series.name: Be My Angel
series.original_name: ฉันหลงรักเทวดาของฉัน
series.overview: Jane, a first-jobber with horrible luck, exchanges her life's worth of merit points for three wishes in the Lucky Points app. However, not only does she not get her wishes fulfilled, she's instead sent Z, a bottom of the barrel angel with absolutely zero skills.

series.name: Duang with You
series.original_name: ด้วงกับเธอ
series.overview: After a festival confession, art student Duang sets out to win over a guarded music major, slowly turning first love into a safe haven for them both.

series.name: Love(X) Mini Series: Roommates in Love
series.original_name: Love(X) Mini Series: Roommates in Love
series.overview: Starring its iconic guests, this anthology explores love's boundless forms. Six vignettes, six flutters. Each unfolds a distinct chapter in the spectrum of emotion!

series.name: My Romance Scammer
series.original_name: รักจริง หลังแต่ง
series.overview: After marrying a con artist for love, a billionaire heir must navigate a messy prenuptial trap while his cousin falls for another scammer.

series.name: Aarti Anjali Awasthi
series.original_name: Aarti Anjali Awasthi
series.overview: Aarti Anjali Awasthi

series.name: Money, My Love
series.original_name: ก็รักมันปักใจ
series.overview: A disillusioned billionaire heir Trai abandons his fortune and hides among ordinary people, where he falls for Phakbung, a day laborer who believes money is everything. As love deepens, Trai must confront his fear that wealth will once again come before true love.

series.name: The Gift
series.original_name: ลางปริศนา
series.overview: Boonsita, who has always seen the future, suddenly gains the ability to glimpse the past when she meets Warat, a man haunted by dreams of a mysterious woman. Together, they uncover long-hidden secrets of love and destiny, confronting truths that have been concealed across time.

series.name: The Seven Legends
series.original_name: 7 ประจัญบาน
series.overview: A former soldier haunted by his past assembles a team of unlikely warriors to dismantle a powerful criminal empire threatening the nation.

series.name: I Wanna Be Sup'Tar
series.original_name: วันหนึ่งจะเป็นซุปตาร์
series.overview: A disgraced superstar with nothing left ends up living under the same roof as an ordinary supporting actress. As house rules pile up and egos collide, their dysfunctional cohabitation spirals into sharp humor, constant friction, and consequences neither can avoid.

series.name: Friends on Fire
series.original_name: กุหลาบเล่นไฟ
series.overview: The friendship between Parita and Ranchita collapses after a tragic death among their circle, all linked to Thanon, the man they all loved. As revenge unfolds, the stakes go far beyond pride, threatening to take everything they can never reclaim.

series.name: Stolen Identity
series.original_name: พลอยน้ำเพชร
series.overview: Nongnuch accepts a surrogacy offer for Namphet, a middle-aged woman yearning for motherhood, to support her husband Somdech's treatment. When Namphet's situation changes, Ploy, the baby girl, ends up living with Nongnuch in a slum, growing up without knowing her true biological relationship. Ploy takes on various roles to provide for her family, with Klatawan's support. Namphet's relentless search for her daughter ends with Ploy, and she secretly helps her. Nongnuch becomes aware of Namphet's affluence and schemes to use Ploy for her benefit.

series.name: Yesterday
series.original_name: รอยรัก วันวาน
series.overview: To reclaim his legacy, a betrayed heir teams up with an old ally to battle a ruthless half-brother now ruling a massive business empire.

series.name: Frozen Valentine
series.original_name: ปิ๊งรักคุณพี่เย็นชา
series.overview: Two former classmates, one an heiress with a past crush and the other a rising star model, reunite when they're cast in a Girls' Love series. Pingrak—formerly a nerd, now a beautiful, ultra-rich heiress to a massive department store empire—once had a secret crush on P'Charm, her former ice-cold senior and a school star. Today, she's a rising model. Back then, she brought her horrible sadness. From a love that was once one-sided between them, the two are suddenly thrown together as the leads in a Girls' Love series.

series.name: Heart Code
series.original_name: สืบลับจับใจ
series.overview: After the attempted attack on a senior police officer, the Special Crime Suppression Unit launches a training camp to identify elite female officers. Among them is Captain Thara, a well-known officer who grows close to Vicky, unaware that Vicky is the daughter of the senior officer linked to her father’s death 19 years ago.

series.name: Universe of Love
series.original_name: ดาวพฤกษ์ The Series
series.overview: Upcountry guy Natee moves to Bangkok where he stays at the home of tidy introvert Pruek. Pruek has to adjust to living with cheerful Natee. Pruek develops a fondness for Natee, though he dares not admit it. At university, Natee makes friends with Earth and June and the three join a club run by odd art professor Niti. When Pruek's close friend Sun first comes to visit at the house, he develops an instant affection for Natee. He begins pursuing him, much to Pruek's discomfort. Furthermore, whenever Sun and Earth meet, there's tension.

series.name: Play Park
series.original_name: รักไม่คาดฝัน
series.overview: An unexpected romance that blossoms in the colorful setting of an amusement park between Lilin, a heir to a powerful family business, and Ing Ing, the diligent amusement park manager.

series.name: The Masked Hearts
series.original_name: นายโขน
series.overview: A modern khon rivalry sparks when a cosplay enthusiast and a traditionalist club president discover their connection mirrors a forbidden past-life love.

series.name: Venus's Groom
series.original_name: เจ้าบ่าวของดาวพระศุกร์
series.overview:
Blinded by rage and consumed by the need to avenge his brother, Pakin kidnaps a luxury hotel heir, holding him captive in the unforgiving wilderness. But fate plays a cruel trick: his hostage might not be the culprit he believes he is.

Beneath identical faces lies a stark difference one is a fire ready to burn, the other is water ready to heal. Can he tell them apart? And in the heart of the wild, how will forced proximity turn a sworn enemy into a lover?

series.name: Running Man Thailand
series.original_name: รันนิ่งแมนไทยแลนด์ อย่า หยุด วิ่ง
series.overview: Alliances are formed and friendships tested as seven top celebrities compete in thrilling missions to win the race.

series.name: Aroma of Affection
series.original_name: กลิ่นมาลี
series.overview: Mali, a famed beauty whose natural fragrance captivates the elite becomes the obsession of Luang Inthrabhodi, a powerful warrior sworn to protect the kingdom. Determined to claim her as his wife despite rigid class divisions and public scorn, he defies convention—only to be trapped in an arranged marriage to a noblewoman. As desire collides with duty, the two lovers must confront the social barriers threatening to keep them apart.

series.name: My Only Sunshine
series.original_name: ตะวันระฟ้า
series.overview: When Sun’s love, Rafah, falls for a famous actress, she dives into the entertainment world, where ambition, romance, and rivalry blur the lines between dreams and desire.

series.name: Oops! I'm the Concubine
series.original_name: มเหสีน้อย
series.overview: Free-spirited commoner Lina unexpectedly becomes a candidate to wed the cold and duty-bound Prince Kiran, but as she navigates palace rivalries and political intrigue, she discovers she may be the key to exposing a rebellion—and the consort destined for him all along.

series.name: Misty Hearts
series.original_name: หัวใจในสายหมอก
series.overview: Mei Lin, a burnout cartoonist. Come to Phayao Province to find new inspiration. Unexpectedly, they meet Niran, a discreet and sober hotel manager who has a heart hidden from a small misunderstanding on the first day, gradually becoming learning about each other, through travel, art, nature, and honest conversations.

series.name: Only Friends: Dream On
series.original_name: เล่นกับเพื่อนได้มากกว่าเพื่อน
series.overview: Senior theater student Jack sets out to create an ambitious stage production, Romeo and Romeo-a bold, male-male re-imagining of the classic Romeo and Juliet. What begins as a dream project soon becomes an emotional minefield when Jack casts friends, exes and their admirers. As rehearsals intensify, unresolved feelings, unspoken crushes, desire, jealousy, and rivalry spiral out of control. Caught between art and emotion, six friends find their relationships tested to the limit.

series.name: Way To You
series.original_name: Way To You
series.overview: The China–Thailand male duo live reality show is coming! The boys are ready. A journey to find destined partners is about to begin.

series.name: Shock Me Girls
series.original_name: รักช็อตใจ ยัยช็อตฟีล
series.overview: This story follows the misadventures of bold high school girls whose tangled crushes lead to confessions, mismatched expectations, and unexpected sparks.

series.name: Love Like a Bike
series.original_name: ปั่นไปให้ถึงรัก
series.overview: Three brothers running a bike cafe embark on a cycling journey to heal past traumas and find love in the sun-drenched streets of Pattaya.

series.name: The Sun from Another Star
series.original_name: อาทิตย์ดาวตก
series.overview: Daotok, the artistic boy who can speak to spirits, is reluctantly pulled by his neighbor Arthit into searching for the soul of his late mother. Yet the more they chase after the dead, the more their living hearts fill with something new.

series.name: Heartstrings
series.original_name: เมื่อหัวใจยังมีเธอ
series.overview: Mei Ling, a photographer and Li Wei, an architect sets out for Chiang Mai with a simple agreement, no phone, no talk about work, and no quarrels, the story of a couple who have to choose whether to let go of each other or come back to hold their hands.

series.name: Pinanong
series.original_name: ปิ่นอนงค์
series.overview: On Thailand’s largest dairy farm, a young woman must navigate family secrets, a returning heir, and forbidden love that could change her life forever.

series.name: Girl from Nowhere: The Reset
series.original_name: เด็กใหม่ The Reset
series.overview: In a new universe, the mysterious Nanno poses as a transfer student, exposing cruelty by turning power, guilt and desire against those who abuse them.

series.name: Girl Rules
series.original_name: กฎหลัก...ห้ามรักเธอ
series.overview:
A friend group descends into chaos as their bonds are tested in a variety of ways, beginning with the return of an ex-girlfriend.

Prim and Min are running an advertising company together when a new client Bambi, Prim's ex, shows up wanting to get back together. Adding to their circle is Prim's young stylist Gorya who's after a deeper connection, promiscuous and charming model Shasha, and Praew, the lesbian photographer from the bar bi-curious Min frequents.

series.name: Bling Bling
series.original_name: เพชรประกาย
series.overview: A world where desire sparkles, ambition collides, and love cuts deeper than diamonds

series.name: Cupid Wall: Love At Post Sight
series.original_name: Cupid Wall – Love at Post Sight
series.overview: At a university, a famous wall known as the "Cupid Wall" allows students to leave notes with their contact information in hopes of finding love. According to the rule, anyone who takes a note must only contact that one person. As different students connect through the wall, unexpected friendships, misunderstandings, and romantic relationships begin to develop. Among them, two young men find themselves drawn to each other, leading to a sweet and emotional love story.

series.name: Wrong Side of the Rainbow
series.original_name: รักหักหลัง
series.overview: When love is twisted into a weapon, pain becomes inevitable. Bound in a complex relationship, Pan, Pie, and Win find themselves entangled in secrets that threaten to destroy them all, as hidden truths slowly surface and push their bonds to the breaking point.

series.name: 7 Destinies
series.original_name: 7 Destinies
series.overview:
When Ice and Nita embark on a journey to find the seven wishes in order to discover the "true love" they are searching for.

From one place to another, from the value of prayers to feelings that begin to change, and to the final prayer that may never be fulfilled.

When hearts become the stakes in this journey, what will be their ultimate fate?

series.name: Hometown Romance
series.original_name: คุณแฟนบ้านนอก
series.overview: Si, a high-society heiress, dreams of becoming the president of her family’s company. However, her parents give the position to her younger sister instead, believing Si is too spoiled and irresponsible, spending millions without a second thought. When the family business faces a crisis involving a crucial land lease renewal, negotiations fail—until Klaokavee, the landowner, makes an unusual proposal: she will renew the lease only if Si agrees to marry her. Despite their completely opposite lifestyles, this strange arrangement brings the two into an unexpected and complicated relationship.

series.name: Love's Shattered Reflections
series.original_name: โทษฐานที่รักเธอ
series.overview: Forced to take on the role of a villain, a once-good man watches his loved ones betray him and his promising future collapse into a living nightmare. Driven by injustice, he sets out to confront those responsible and reclaim what was taken—no matter the cost.

series.name: Shades
series.original_name: เด็ก เรียบ ร้าย
series.overview: Six different students and one teacher each have secrets that are about to be revealed: love that ought to be kept secret, hidden identities, and the truth that no one dares face.

series.name: Wooju Bakery
series.original_name: 우주 빵집
series.overview: An alien prince crashes into a baker’s grand opening, forcing the two into an unlikely partnership to rebuild the shop and find a home.

series.name: Bro
series.original_name: พี่ครับ
series.overview: Earth has to live with his older brother Kan — who isn't his blood brother. Because Kan was dumped by his wife, Earth's stepfather sends him to take care of Kan. But one drunken night a mistake is made that changes the course of their relationship forever.

series.name: Magic Move
series.original_name: ทำนายทายรัก
series.overview: An architecture student becomes a viral fortune teller by mistake, only to find his accurate predictions leading him into a chaotic romance.

series.name: The Bangkok Red Opera
series.original_name: สอดสร้อยมาลา
series.overview: When the friendship between two royal dancers is threatened by the love of two young men, it becomes a turning point, leading to a deep rift.

series.name: Fulfill
series.original_name: Fulfill รักเติมเต็ม
series.overview: From college sweethearts to lifelong partners, Pafun and Aioon build a loving, devoted life together—dreaming of a family that seems just out of reach. When Pafun’s longing for motherhood deepens, their hope grows around the promise of adopting a child someday. Everything changes when their best friend, Nubnueng, returns unexpectedly and brings a life-altering opportunity. As love, loss, and responsibility collide, the couple must navigate heartbreak, resilience, and the challenges of becoming new parents. Fulfill is a tender, emotional journey that celebrates chosen family and the power of love to complete what life leaves unfinished.

series.name: Love My Job
series.original_name: Love My Job
series.overview:
“The First Day of Office Hell and the Crazy Competition” Namtao, an ordinary girl, enters an office where nothing is normal. From the motorcycle taxi driver to the receptionist who looks exactly like the CEO, everyone seems to come from the universe of The Face Thailand.

She must survive sarcastic coworkers, office gossip, and wild revenge fantasies that are stronger than reality. Things get crazier when CEO Perry announces an office runway competition.

The loser must enter the Black Room. The winner gets extra vacation leave.

The office becomes a fashion battlefield full of team politics and drama that is both funny and painfully real. The season ends with a fake elimination into the Black Room that makes the whole crew almost laugh on set."

series.name: Love of Silom
series.original_name: รักแห่งสีลม
series.overview: A heartbroken cop hiding a forbidden love finds a second chance at love when he rescues a struggling student at a nightclub in Silom.

series.name: Flower Boy
series.original_name: หลงกลิ่นเกสร
series.overview: A cold CEO abducts a magical being to steal his irresistible scent, only to find the fragrance—and his survival—depends on winning his victim's heart.

series.name: Let's Begin Again
series.original_name: รักได้หรือ Young
series.overview: After being betrayed by her first love, Wayruree struggles to trust in romance again. Everything changes when she meets Mr. TJ, who guides her personal growth and teaches her the true meaning of love, helping her heal and open her heart once more.

series.name: One Year
series.original_name: One Year เลือนรางและ…จางหาย
series.overview: After moving home to escape a deadly curse, Kim falls for a chef whose memory resets daily, forcing him to win the man’s heart every morning.

series.name: Whisper of Desire
series.original_name: สกุณาซ่อนรัก
series.overview: Two families share a close bond, but beneath the surface lies a series of concealed truths. As relationships evolve and tensions rise, each character’s hidden past and motivations begin to emerge.

series.name: Secrecy
series.original_name: ลับ-รัก
series.overview: Superstar Prin shines under the spotlight, seemingly having it all. Yet behind the scenes, his personal life and emotions are tightly controlled, never meant to be revealed, with Foon managing his private life. As Prin's career reaches new heights, the delicate balance between them begins to shift. Can they keep their relationship hidden, or will their unspoken feelings start to slip beyond control?

series.name: My Staycation Boy
series.original_name: คุณวันหยุดของผม
series.overview: When Phut, a workaholic office worker, gets so drunk that he can’t open the door to his own room, he ends up accidentally walking into a stranger’s apartment, thinking it’s his best friend’s place next door. The next morning, he discovers the truth—the man is Sunday, his friend’s twin brother, who has just moved in.

series.name: Burning Desire
series.original_name: ปรารถนารักต้องห้าม
series.overview: Run infiltrates the city's largest mafia family to avenge his deceased father. Unexpectedly, he catches the eye of Chai, the head of the family, and becomes Chai's fiancé. Run decides to go along with the plan, only to be reunited with Win, who is Chai's son and Run's former flame. Faced with Win’s repeated "forced love" and aggressive pursuits, how will Run choose his path forward...?

series.name: Enemies with Benefits
series.original_name: ลัลล์ไม่ชอบไวน์
series.overview: Head of Sales Lal is determined to triumph over Head of Accounting Wine. Wine is her polar opposite and known for her mercilessness. When a wild night leads them to a friends with benefits relationship, they'll do anything to keep it a secret, pretending to be enemies so that absolutely no one at work finds out. Without realising it, however, their newfound closeness begins to give way to love.

series.name: The Rhythm of Revenge
series.original_name: เพลงรักพยัคฆ์ร้าย
series.overview: Singer Puna dreams of stardom and uncovering the truth behind her parents' deaths, forming an alliance with a police officer as the hunt turns personal.

series.name: WU
series.original_name: WU อู
series.overview: A demon-marked outcast and a mysterious hunter team up to fight dark forces and forge a bond that may go beyond fate.

series.name: Love Beyond Dreams
series.original_name: เพื่อเธออีกครั้ง
series.overview: Aran, 21, believed her bond with Lene was more than sisterly-until a harsh rejection sent her abroad. A letter calls her back to Thailand, where she finds Lene dead. After the funeral, she wakes five years earlier, determined to save her.

series.name: Crash Course in Romance
series.original_name: คอร์ส(ลัด)สูตรโรแมนซ์
series.overview: A struggling single mother hires a brilliant but cold tutor for her daughter – only to develop an unexpected connection.

series.name: Eternal Rain
series.original_name: ฝนล้านฤดู
series.overview: When the rain starts to gather and forms into a storm, it becomes the cause of a war of wits, a struggle for power, conflict and “love” amidst “death”. Who will be the only one to win this game?

series.name: Crazy Love, Moo-Moo!
series.original_name: พี่ฟากชอบเธอมู่
series.overview: To drive away a persistent admirer, MooMoo interns at his hotel to show off his worst habits, only to find himself falling for the man he hates.

series.name: Your Dear Daddy
series.original_name: เรียกแด๊ดสิธาร
series.overview: Exiled from home, a man finds solace in Chiang Rai, where a guarded man helps him heal—and teaches him how to love in return.

series.name: Hearts Aglow
series.original_name: เงารักใต้แสงเทียน
series.overview: Loy, a city boy seeking peace, escapes to a rural homestay where he meets Kaew, a gentle soul rooted in tradition. Amid shared meals, rain-soaked evenings, and simple rituals, their quiet moments blossom into a tender love. Beyond their story, other relationships unfold within the homestay, each carrying its own form of love. Three different connections, each shining in its own way.

series.name: The Emotion
series.original_name: รัก ลวง เลว
series.overview: The story follows the intertwined relationships of six young men whose bonds evolve in unexpected ways. It begins by exploring the origin of a tragic love that spirals into obsession and moral darkness.

series.name: When Oranges Fall
series.original_name: ต้นส้มอยู่บ้านเขา แต่ผลส้มหล่นมาบ้านเราตลอดเลย
series.overview: In the 90s, two polar-opposite classmates with the same nickname find their mutual dislike turning to love after a stray orange brings them together.

series.name: Wicked Temptation
series.original_name: พยัคฆ์ร้ายซ่อนลาย
series.overview: After his adoptive father is killed by the secret organization Fire Phoenix, Taiga travels to Thailand to uncover the truth. Infiltrating a powerful corporation linked to the criminal underworld, he searches for the mysterious “Demon” while clashing with Rin, a guarded bodyguard who shares a tragic connection to the same conspiracy.

series.name: My Grandpa Is a BL Writer
series.original_name: คุณปู่วุ่น Y หลานชาย Y วุ่น
series.overview: To save his family's orphanage from foreclosure, a macho 75-year-old novelist must team up with his Gen Z grandson to write a hit BL novel.

series.name: The Air
series.original_name: เสน่หาวาโย
series.overview: When a violent coup erupts back home, Princess Catherine Blew De Laina becomes an assassination target while visiting Thailand. Her survival falls entirely on Lieutenant 'Lom' Vayo Watinwanich, a sharp female marine police officer assigned as her underground protector. Forced off the grid, the two women must navigate relentless tactical hits and political betrayal. As duty and survival blur, their isolation sparks an intense, undeniable magnetic attraction—a forbidden love defying rigid military protocol and royal expectations. Amidst constant gunfire, Blew finds safety in Lom's embrace, while Lom discovers a kindred spirit beneath the royal exterior. In a world where everyone has a price, their fierce devotion becomes both their ultimate liability and their only way out. Together, they must dismantle the conspiracy before the assassins close in.

series.name: ChermChey
series.original_name: เฉิ่มเชย
series.overview: After one last wish for love, a heartbroken man meets a bold bar owner whose relentless care slowly breaks through his walls.

series.name: CLOUD DREAM project
series.original_name: CLOUD DREAM project
series.overview: A documentary series following the journey of seven artists. Though they come from different backgrounds, they share the same dream of performing on a global stage.

series.name: Dance of the Lion
series.original_name: สิงโตลำซิ่ง
series.overview: Amid pressure and fierce competition, the sounds of the khaen, the phin, and the lively mor lam sing rhythms become the driving force that allows the Singto Kimhan troupe to stand strong once again.

series.name: Falling for My Hater
series.original_name: พักหัวใจที่ยัยแอนตี้แฟน
series.overview: A top actress goes into hiding at a valley guesthouse after a scandal ruins her career. There, she meets the sharp-tongued guesthouse owner, who despises celebrities, and who also turns out to be behind the anonymous leak online that destroyed her reputation.

series.name: Sunset in Winter
series.original_name: เหมันต์ตะวันรอน
series.overview: Prince Rawi, forced into a loveless marriage, is betrayed by his wife’s affair and her deadly plot against him. After falling into an abyss during the confrontation, he wakes with amnesia in a village, starting a new life as Tawan under Lukjan’s care.

series.name: Pretend Lover
series.original_name: กลรักอลเวง
series.overview: Poor street kid Nawin, while working to pay off his father's debts, impulsively kisses wealthy heir Metha to escape loan sharks.
