To his surprise, Metha proposes a deal: pretend to be his boyfriend to escape an arranged marriage with heiress Lily. Despite his disdain for spoiled rich kids, Nawin agrees to help in exchange for clearing his father's debt. The two must convincingly play the role of a couple, even coming out as gay to Metha's family. As they navigate this charade in Metha's home and workplace, their initial animosity turns into mutual attraction. When Lily and Nawin's admirer Pete discover the ruse, their attempts to sabotage the relationship backfire, pushing Nawin and Metha to confess their true feelings. Ultimately, Nawin helps Metha reclaim his family's company from his stepmother, earning their respective father's blessings for the unexpected love.

series.name: A Dog and a Plane
series.original_name: หมาเห่าเครื่องบิน
series.overview: After a chaotic luggage mix-up, a broke paramedic and an ambitious flight attendant grow closer while exposing a cheating boyfriend’s secrets.

series.name: Chasing Love
series.original_name: พี่เองก็ลำบาก
series.overview:
Song, a hot nerd and food researcher, arranged a one-night stand with a mysterious woman under a strict condition: no strings attached. However, the other party broke the terms, asking for an emotional connection. Song ended the steamy encounter and walked away.

But the world really is round. That woman turned out to be Piangrawin—the daughter of the president of the company where Song worked. And Piangrawin wasn’t letting go easily. She pursued her with puppy-like devotion, entangling Song's heart and routine with reckless charm. She even claimed she’d already named their future child.

series.name: Payback
series.original_name: เพย์แบค เดอะซีรีส์
series.overview: A grieving debt collector enters the entertainment world for revenge, only to fall into a dangerous attraction with a powerful executive.

series.name: Ticket to Heaven
series.original_name: เด็กชายไม่ไปสวรรค์
series.overview: A grieving student pursuing priesthood faces a crisis of faith when he falls for a troubled new classmate in a world ruled by strict dogma.

series.name: My Wife's Gunslinger God
series.original_name: ถึงคุณภรรยา...จากสามีที่รัก
series.overview: A school teacher with dreams of becoming a professional gamer is forced to marry her childhood first love, whose hatred of video games puts their relationship to the test.

series.name: Keaw Pis Dan
series.original_name: แก้วพิสดาร
series.overview: Born from a magical jewel and raised in exile, Phra Kaeo embarks on an epic journey filled with romance, war, and adventure. As conflicts between humans and giants escalate, he finds himself torn between two women whose lives become deeply intertwined with his destiny.

series.name: Dear Enemy
series.original_name: ทุกอณูฤทัย
series.overview: M.R. Nareerat Warorot reluctantly enters a marriage with Mom Chao Athitat Narangkul to investigate his suspected ties to an opium trade. As she navigates the deception, her mission becomes complicated when unexpected feelings of love begin to develop, blurring the line between duty and desire.

series.name: The Two Faces of Thatri
series.original_name: ธาตรี
series.overview: After losing everything to his lavish lifestyle, bankrupt socialite Thatri Thatriphan crosses paths with a wealthy childhood friend who shares the same name. When a tragic train bombing leaves the friend incapacitated, Thatri is asked to assume his identity and claim a vast inheritance—pulling him into a risky deception that could either restore his fortune or destroy him completely.

series.name: The Evil Lawyer
series.original_name: ทนายปีศาจ
series.overview: When a young attorney is accused of murdering a police officer's son, he teams up with the "Evil Lawyer" to exploit loopholes and prove his innocence.

series.name: The Outlaws: Revengeful Judgement
series.original_name: สี่เสือแดนสยาม: ไฟล้างไฟ
series.overview: All four tigers of Siam are in the same situation, which is being arrested by the authorities. Police Lieutenant Colonel Rat Burapapayak, a crime suppression officer nicknamed 'Sergeant Raj Kao Chiwit', is ready to do anything to bring all four of them down.

series.name: Greatest Memory
series.original_name: ความทรงจำที่ยิ่งใหญ่
series.overview: Boyd is an ordinary office worker whose life changes after he is assisted by Ohm on the Bangkok Skytrain. Their encounter blossoms into a sweet, nostalgic romance set against familiar local backdrops

series.name: Under the Working Desk
series.original_name: ใต้โต๊ะทำงาน
series.overview: After being laid off at 45, a Gen Y professional gets a second chance by building a startup with a team of Gen Z coworkers.

series.name: Muifei the Medium
series.original_name: มุ่ยเฟย
series.overview: A young woman destined to suffer as a tribal spirit medium is rescued by a city outsider who falls in love with her. But after tragedy strikes, she returns as a vengeful spirit seeking justice against those who abused her.

series.name: Strong Will
series.original_name: ลูกผู้ชายหัวใจเพชร
series.overview: A gifted, humbly born musician and a wealthy student fall for each other amid personal rivalries and a life-changing accident.

series.name: The Scammer Games
series.original_name: เกมโกงเกมส์
series.overview: Eight con artists are forced into an uneasy partnership to carry out a high-risk scheme against the criminals behind a vast illegal business empire.

series.name: In Love Forever
series.original_name: วาดฝันวันวิวาห์
series.overview:
After a bitter divorce caused by family pressure and emotional manipulation, successful lawyer Runchlaphat and outspoken Gen-Z heiress Peeracha want nothing to do with each other. But when a high-stakes business opportunity requires them to appear as a happily married couple, the former lovers are forced back under the same roof.

As they struggle to maintain the illusion, unresolved feelings and painful memories begin to resurface. Meanwhile, Runchlaphat’s controlling mother, Gingkamol, remains determined to keep Peeracha out of the family at all costs. Surrounded by deception, pride, and lingering desire, the ex-wives find themselves trapped between the love they once shared and the wounds they never healed.

series.name: Lost to Light
series.original_name: อยากจะดังหรือยังนะ
series.overview: An idol group that once dreamed of fame now faces the humiliation of singing children’s songs dressed as mascots. Everyone quits… except Jeng, who chooses to stay by the stubborn Boss Sithian.

series.name: The Edge of Horizon
series.original_name: อรุณรุ่ง
series.overview: Years after being torn apart by rank and tradition, a prince and his first love reunite as buried feelings bloom once more.

series.name: Listen to My Heartbeat
series.original_name: ฟังเสียงหัวใจของฉัน
series.overview:
Gun, a young heir of an ancient noble family, has carried a curse since birth — an incurable blood disease that will claim his life before he turns 30. That is, until he discovers the only way out: marrying Bank, an ordinary chef who possesses a hidden power within him. Gun knows all too well that should this marriage be "consummated," Bank will die in his place.

But as the days pass and they grow closer, feelings that were never supposed to exist begin to take root without either of them noticing. And as the clock ticks ever closer to his 30th birthday, the heaviest question of his life haunts him without rest — between his own life and the life of the one he loves, what will he choose?

series.name: My Tutor, My Love
series.original_name: ติวเธอ(ร์)...ที่รัก
series.overview: When fame becomes a burden and criticism leaves wounds, crossing paths with this tutoring guy… will it be a lesson, or a test of the heart?

series.name: When Light Fades
series.original_name: แสงดาวแสงศรัทธา
series.overview: During Thailand’s 1976 crackdown, a fugitive student finds love with a guerrilla fighter while battling for freedom and survival.

series.name: Don't Be Too Emotional
series.original_name: อย่าขอพี่เจน
series.overview: A football player befriends a mysterious wish-granter whose dangerous gifts hide secrets that draw them closer together.

series.name: Beneath the Moon's Shadow
series.original_name: ปริศนาใต้เงาจันทร์
series.overview: One night, a mysterious series of murders occurs, and all victims are connected to "Kantakwee," a famous young actor. Later, "Lieutenant Thara," a tough female police officer, finds the body of "Natcha," a lawyer and her sworn enemy, lying in a pool of blood, murdered by the killer. Thara miraculously saves Natcha's life, but when Natcha recovers, she has lost almost all of her memory. Natcha becomes a key witness that Thara must protect 24/7. However, Natcha's amnesia makes Thara wonder if she is truly a victim or the killer... As they live together to uncover the truth, their closeness gradually transforms into a bond. But danger lurks in their relationship every minute, as the serial killer relentlessly hunts Natcha! As Natcha's memories slowly return, she draws closer to death. Can her former rival become her lover?

series.name: The Hidden Shadow
series.original_name: ปราการแสงจันทร์
series.overview: After a helicopter crash, struggling writer Jilla is forced into a dead socialite's identity — and thrust into a powerful family's deadly web of secrets.

series.name: The Running of Love and Money
series.original_name: The Running เงิน งาน ความรัก
series.overview: A group of friends known as Gen Me navigate lives filled with love, dreams, and the challenges of survival in a fast-paced society. As they enter adulthood, they struggle with relationships, personal aspirations, and growing responsibilities, learning difficult lessons along the way while relying on one another for support.

series.name: Black Coral
series.original_name: ปะการังสีดำ
series.overview: While searching for a legendary coral reef near a cursed island, a marine biologist uncovers a web of conspiracies, local legends, and hidden crimes that threaten both his mission and his life.

series.name: Knot
series.original_name: นอต
series.overview: A young man’s life changes forever when a powerful Alpha marks him, binding their fates together in an inescapable bond.

series.name: Trapped by My Ex's Uncle
series.original_name: กับดักหัวใจนายหมาป่า
series.overview: Thach discovers that her childhood sweetheart, Ben, is cheating on her. After getting drunk at a nightclub, she spends the night with the nightclub's "top pick," Thee, unaware that Thee is actually Ben's long-lost uncle who has just returned from abroad. Ben, using Thach's mother's medical expenses as leverage, demands that Thach maintain a facade of being his girlfriend until he inherits his grandmother's fortune. Thach reluctantly agrees but is horrified to encounter Thee again at a family gathering, realizing that the nightclub's top pick is Ben's uncle. Thach is determined to cut ties with this messy situation, but Thee is relentless. He not only schemes to have Thach and Ben move into the family home with him, where he constantly flirts with Thach, but also becomes the new CEO of Thach and Ben's company, helping Thach grow professionally. Seven years ago, Thee was just one step too late and missed his chance with Thach. Now, he vows never to let her go again.

series.name: AI Girl
series.original_name: จะ Gen จนกว่าจะเจอ
series.overview: One day, a package arrives at quirky introvert Gen's doorstop. When she opens the package, she discovers a truly human-like robot, beautiful like the girl of Gen's dreams. While trying to find a way to send the robot back, Gen accidentally hits a button that has the robot opening her eyes and coming to life. With the beautiful, flirtatious, playful and sexy robot by her side, Gen is completely swayed and decides to keep her, giving her the name Ai.

series.name: My Sexy Shadow
series.original_name: คนโหดบานฉ่ำ
series.overview: Mek, a professional boxer, heads to Bangkok chasing his dream of fighting on the big stage. By chance, he meets Man, an LGBTQ+ cabaret performer who looks exactly like him, like a twin. The two decide to switch identities to investigate the mystery of their origins.

series.name: House 31
series.original_name: House 31

series.name: Mr.Kill
series.original_name: มังงะสั่งตาย
series.overview: When a comic becomes the inspiration for a killer, the author is forced to work with a detective to try and uncover the truth.

series.name: My Summer Internship
series.original_name: ฝึกงานนี้ให้ผมได้กี่เปอร์เซ็นต์%
series.overview: When a meticulously nerdy senior meets a highly creative, influencer junior, what are their chances of success in this summer internship?

series.name: Peach and Me
series.original_name: มีสติแล้วลูกพีช
series.overview: After their wedding, Thee and Peach embrace the joys and chaos of married life while finding their own rhythm together.

series.name: The Fire
series.original_name: โซ่รักอัคนี
series.overview: Fai Atjima and Kaphrao, childhood rivals, cross paths again when Fai mistakenly believes Kaphrao is her father's new young mistress, scheming to steal the family's fortune. Convinced she's a gold digger, Fai makes it her mission to torment her at every turn. But Kaphrao refuses to back down, firing back. As their endless bickering slowly gives way to undeniable attraction, sworn enemies begin to become each other's most important person. When Fai is forced to choose between her duty to her family and the woman who has captured her heart, what will she sacrifice for love?

series.name: Fill the Beat
series.original_name: จังหวะรักต่างเจน
series.overview: In a riverside town, a Gen Z grandson and his Boomer grandfather bridge their generational gap through timeless, classic Suntaraporn music.

series.name: Love Destiny
series.original_name: บุพเพสันนิวาส
series.overview: When a modern surgeon's soul is cast into a hated 17th-century troublemaker, he uses advanced medicine to save lives and win over his fierce rival.

series.name: Be My Player Two
series.original_name: ซอโซ่ล่ามธีร์
series.overview: To win a gaming championship, a famous streamer teams up with his biggest rival, only to risk it all when real feelings ignite.

series.name: Jump
series.original_name: กระโดดคว้ารัก
series.overview: A coming-of-age story of friendship, love, hope, mistakes, backstabbing, and competition.

series.name: Make It Right 2026
series.original_name: รักออกเดิน 2026
series.overview: After his first love falls apart, a student grows closer to a quiet classmate as he and his friends face the highs and lows of young love.

series.name: Water Boyy Drip
series.original_name: Water Boyy Drip
series.overview:
Kinn, the disciplined captain of the swim team, has always had complete control over his life—until First arrives. The new recruit doesn’t back down, doesn’t fall in line, and refuses to leave Kinn’s world unchanged. Drawn together, they blur the line between punishment and desire… crossing it night after night.

But just as Kinn begins to confront what he truly feels, Ohm steps in—someone who knows Kinn better than anyone else, and exactly how to make sure he doesn’t choose someone else. Ohm doesn’t threaten. He plays a smarter game—revealing half-truths at the most painful moments.

First starts to pull away. Kinn is left lost. And the swimming pool that once belonged to them becomes a battlefield.

Until the day their coach forces a choice in front of the entire team.

For the first time in his life, Kinn steps out of line… and chooses for himself.

series.name: I AM WHAT I AM
series.original_name: ตถตา ตัวกู ของกู
series.overview: An aspiring actress lands a role in a legendary stage production where ambition and rivalry run high. After a cast member is murdered, the theater becomes the center of a dark murder investigation.

series.name: Class Crush Crisis
series.original_name: เพื่อนสนิทระวังคิดไม่ซื่อ
series.overview: After transferring to a top high school, aspiring rock star Leerit vows to avoid romance — but quickly changes his tune when he meets his new roommate.

series.name: Hitting Ball
series.original_name: เหงาเท่าจักรวาล
series.overview: A mysterious journey to Hokkaido brings together four strangers whose lives become connected through love, music, and long-buried memories.

series.name: Match Point
series.original_name: รักนี้ต้องเสิร์ฟ
series.overview: When rival shop owners' sons Sun and Bay are forced to play tennis doubles, hiding their secret team gets harder as real romance begins to bloom.

series.name: Your Third
series.original_name: ที่สามของเธอ
series.overview: A secretary sent to retrieve his boss's runaway twin falls for the heartbroken man he's meant to bring home.

series.name: Man of Virtue
series.original_name: หลวงพ่อเสือ
series.overview: When Luang Pho and the gang become suspects in a diamond robbery case, an action-filled mission to restore their honour begins.

series.name: Heart Shaker
series.original_name: เขย่าหัวใจไอ้จอมดื้อ
series.overview: A college intern clashes with a mischievous gardener at a countryside resort, but their rivalry takes a romantic turn when hidden identities and family secrets come to light.

series.name: Some Things Stay
series.original_name: ร้านซ่อมความทรงจำ
series.overview: A woman caring for the brother she once saw as a burden finds their life together slowly healing years of family wounds.

series.name: Treasure Lovers
series.original_name: อุบัติรักเกาะสวรรค์
series.overview: Phadoemphong, who hasn't been able to graduate because of his pleasure-loving and partying lifestyle with his friend Monthian, is sent by his father Khun Phokhakij to manage a coconut trade business on Sawat Island. There, he meets Naphaphon and eventually falls in love with her, completely unaware that she's the daughter of his father's rival in business.

series.name: Still Water
series.original_name: วารี ๑๐๐ ศพ
series.overview: The small town of Wari Pasop appears peaceful, but beneath the calm exterior hides dark secrets. Years earlier, the unexplained disappearance of a woman set off a chain of events leading to a complex series of murders and a race to uncover a well-buried truth.

series.name: Mr. Fanboy
series.original_name: รักสุดใจนายแฟนบอย
series.overview: Cast in a BL drama with his idol, devoted fanboy Wan finds his heart pulled in a shocking new direction by the idol's protective partner, Third.

series.name: You Maniac
series.original_name: เดี๋ยวจะรักซะให้บ้า
series.overview: When a carefree playboy meets the one man who refuses to fall for his charm, his competitive ego turns into an obsession he can't resist.

series.name: Fix You, Fix Me
series.original_name: คลินิก Fix ใจ
series.overview: This series aims to raise awareness of mental health issues that are no longer a distant concern, offering hope, encouragement, and demonstrating that everyone has the chance to start over new, thereby changing Thai society's mindsets around mental health.

series.name: Juliet & Juliet
series.original_name: Juliet & Juliet
series.overview: When the heirs of two rival families turn out to be each other's first love, will the ending be love... or tragedy?

series.name: Fairway of Love
series.original_name: รักออกรอบ
series.overview: "Fairway of Love" revolves around the competitive and romance-filled world of professional golf. The story follows a young, wealthy heiress to a major golf empire whose life takes an unexpected turn when she crosses paths with an enigmatic female golfer on the green.After a literal and figurative clash during a tournament, an intense spark ignites between them. As they navigate the high-stakes pressure of the sport, family expectations, and personal rivalries, they must decide if they are willing to risk everything for a chance at true love.

series.name: Khom Khlang
series.original_name: ข่มขลัง
series.overview: A Bangkok police officer hunting a supernatural human trafficking kingpin teams up with a mysterious spiritual master. As they uncover dark magic and ancient rituals, they discover they are fated soulmates.

series.name: Cycle of Sin
series.original_name: สามเราเอาตาย
series.overview: After Yo discovers that her husband Nat has been cheating on her with his boss Pam, they decide to try repairing their bond by moving away to Nat’s great-grandmother’s house, along with Wan, Yo's trusted assistant. However, their attempts at reconciliation soon go awry when strange, horrifying incidents begin taking place in and around the house, along with the appearance of the mysterious Pete. As Yo tries to figure out what's going on, she realizes that both the house and the people around her are cloaked in secrets and lies, creating a perfect storm of danger that she might not manage to escape from – especially when the past refuses to leave the present alone.

series.name: Pls Love
series.original_name: Pls Love รักได้ไหม
series.overview: Cold and seemingly-perfect business heiress Peem reunites with Pan, a woman she once shared a fleeting seaside romance with–now working as a hostess at a luxury club in Bangkok. Determined to keep her close, Peem hires her as a personal assistant, forcing them to confront unresolved feelings, pride, and painful misunderstandings. As secrets and class differences threaten to pull them apart, both women must decide if they are brave enough to trust and love each other without judgement.

series.name: Police in Love
series.original_name: ที่รักสารวัตรเธียร์
series.overview: A bickering inspector and his subordinate marry for six months to break a curse, but living together turns their fake marriage into real love.

series.name: Third Person
series.original_name: ถ้อยรักคำลวง
series.overview: Chris, a young woman suffering from amnesia, is recovering and living with her loving partner, Nadia, after an accident four years ago. Everything seems to be going well, but then the arrival of a strange woman named Sun begins to shake Chris's beliefs.

series.name: A Parasite's Heart
series.original_name: หัวใจกาฝาก
series.overview: Bound by an unexpected marriage, Hataya and Ramil are outcasts in their families — but that won't deter them from saving their kin to prove their worth.

series.name: Double U
series.original_name: Double U
series.overview: Is it possible to fall in love with someone you have never met? A young man named Soul maintains an unspoken agreement with a mysterious online contact to chat anonymously; they keep their real lives separate, addressing each other only as "Mr. Mars" and "Mr. Neptune." Their worlds collide when Night, a newly hired planner, joins Soul’s company and becomes his partner on a field assignment. Through their collaboration, Night’s gentle and attentive companionship causes Soul to gradually lower his guard, finding himself stirred even by the most casual remarks. As a romantic astronomical event—Mars drawing close to Earth—approaches, they arrange to go stargazing together, and a subtle, romantic tension quietly blossoms between the virtual and the real. When the spark of real-life attraction intersects with the secrets of the online world, will they recognize the person right beside them who has completely transformed their life?

series.name: Oops! Mysterious Sounds
series.original_name: สืบเสียงปริศนา..อุ๊ย! เสียงหัวใจเธอดังกว่า
series.overview: Forced into a fake relationship, college rivals Podduang and Jinna team up to solve an actor's murder using a supernatural earpiece that guides them.

series.name: The Crow Club
series.original_name: อีกาสมาคม
series.overview: Four couples form part of the mysterious Crow Club, where supernatural cases and dangerous missions lead to unexpected romantic bonds.

series.name: The Outlaws: Tigers Wrath
series.original_name: สี่เสือแดนสยาม: โจรพันธุ์เสือ
series.overview: A temple-raised man becomes a feared outlaw but must confront his violent past and hidden origins when a police captain launches a campaign against his gang.

series.name: The D Dorm
series.original_name: หอตัวดี
series.overview: When Dobby declares his intent to sell the D Dorm, he ends up on a mission to track down the first love of the spirit A Kong in exchange for the right. All the while, he has to deal with the residents trying all sorts of methods to prevent the sale.

series.name: Help, I'm Married to a Ghost
series.original_name: ช่วยด้วยผมแต่งงานกับผี
series.overview: Pakin is haunted by the ghost of his classmate Phat, who died five years ago. Seeking help from a shaman, he is advised to hold a ghost marriage. Phat remembers Pakin a bully, and now his spirit is forcefully bound to him. However, Pakin remembers their relationship differently. To help Phat reincarnate, they revisit old places, and the truth is gradually revealed: they had a crush on each other but were separated by misunderstandings. This time, they take a desperate gamble to find a way to stay together forever.

series.name: DON'T SAY NO YET
series.original_name: รู้จนก็ยังจะถามใช่ไหม
series.overview:
Frantz(Ferin), CEO who never takes no for an answer, is on a mission to find a new pastry chef for her hotel after the previous chef suddenly quits. Her search leads her to Nize (Puifai), a talented pastry chef and seaside cafe owner known for her meticulous craft. But Nize has turned down every hotel that has approached her, determined never to return to the hotel industry.

When one refuses to give up and the other refuses to change her mind, Frantz will do whatever it takes to make Nize say yes. But the closer she gets, the more their relationship begins to change from a mission to recruit a chef into a journey of discovering what their hearts truly want...

series.name: Lock Love Game
series.original_name: ล็อก เลิฟ เกม เรียลลิตี้
series.overview: When hearts are locked in the ultimate game of love! Get ready for fun, sweetness, and exciting challenges, and join us to see who will successfully lock each other’s hearts!

series.name: Delusion
series.original_name: ภาพลวงตาย
series.overview: When her father's worsening dementia makes him a prime suspect in a murder case, a small-town school teacher races to uncover the truth amid dark rumors.

series.name: Fake Marriage, Love with the Chairman
series.original_name: วิวาห์ลวง(รัก)ท่านประธาน
series.overview:
In order to earn money for his mother's medical treatment and prevent his house from being demolished, Pai decides to "seduce" Tim, the tyrannical young president. Eventually, Pai becomes the president's

"special little husband," and is forced to become a reluctant stepmother, helping Tim care for his children.

Pi thought the marriage was just a mutually beneficial agreement that would end when the time was up. But he didn't know that every time they touched, Tim could hear every thought in his mind, the secret that Pi had been trying to keep could no longer be concealed.

series.name: Not Yours
series.original_name: 非你之物
series.overview: A young man moves in with his wealthy creditor as a "sugar baby" to pay off his bankrupt father's debts, but their contractual arrangement gets complicated when a celebrity idol enters the picture.

series.name: Thailand's Chosen One
series.original_name: จังหวะแห่งภูฏาน
series.overview: Between dazzling staging and show-stopping performances, Thailand's national selection show promises to be a spectacular celebration of music. Which song will viewers vote to represent the Host Country at Eurovision Song Contest Asia? Tune in to find out live!

series.name: Murder in The Kitchen
series.original_name: สำรับฆาตกร

series.name: Decoding You
series.original_name: โคตรรัก
series.overview: Krit, a data analytics CEO pressured by a scandal and his mother, enters a fake marriage with his adopted brother Nont. As Nont attracts others, Krit's hidden feelings emerge, forcing him to choose between his family empire and love.

series.name: THE POWER 2026
series.original_name: THE POWER 2026

series.name: The Soulmate Rings
series.original_name: แหวนรักข้ามเวลา
series.overview: A popular influencer prepares to marry her down-to-earth boyfriend, but the couple must prove their love again when their rings send them back in time.

series.name: Beneath the Lies
series.original_name: ตะวันลวง

series.name: Dark Legacy
series.original_name: มรดกมืด
series.overview: A wealthy man's estranged family gathers at his remote mansion to compete for his inheritance, but an unseen killer begins picking them off one by one.

series.name: Fool in Love
series.original_name: คนโง่รักเข(ล)า
series.overview: A powerful heir uses business to pursue an aristocrat, only to become hopelessly entangled in a romantic trap of his own making.

series.name: The Legacy
series.original_name: บัลลังก์มาร
series.overview: Aranee enters the prestigious Somsuriyan family as a new daughter-in-law, only to find herself caught in a web of family rivalries, inheritance disputes, and secrets surrounding a past tragedy. As she searches for the truth, the family's carefully maintained image begins to unravel.

series.name: Good Boy
series.original_name: จิรภัทรจะเป็นเด็กดี
series.overview: Reborn at 17 to fix past mistakes, Jiraphat finds his life taking an unexpected turn when he falls deeply for his long-forgotten childhood friend, Ruth.

series.name: Hell Home
series.original_name: บ้านขุมนรก
series.overview: A forbidden relationship shakes a powerful church family when it exposes infidelity and a mysterious murder, prompting a lawyer to uncover secrets buried between two families.

series.name: Teach Me, Touch Me
series.original_name: สัมผัสกันต์ธีร์
series.overview: Dumped for being too vanilla, Gear hires a playboy to teach him passion, but their intimate lessons soon become real love.

series.name: Badminton Boys
series.original_name: กัปตันครับ ผมจะจีบพี่
series.overview: Zumo, the formidable and aloof captain dominating the university badminton scene, unexpectedly crosses paths with Kao—a tall, handsome, and rebellious freshman. Not only does Kao arrive late on his first day with plenty of bravado, but he also brazenly challenges Zumo on the court, knocking the "undefeated king" to the ground with a single smash. Their explosive confrontation catches the eye of their cunning coach, who issues a strict ultimatum: the two sworn rivals must team up for men's doubles. To make matters worse, the coach imposes a bizarre rule: they must remain inseparable at all times, both on and off the court. The dynamic between the two—shifting from fierce adversaries to a forced duo—begins to change as Kao’s relentless persistence slowly breaks down the icy wall Zumo has built around himself.

series.name: Prince's First Love
series.original_name: รักแรกของเจ้าชาย
series.overview: The arrogant Prince 'Phawin' uses his power to coerce race car driver 'Thanwa' into a secret sugar daddy contract. Their relationship begins with heated arguments but develops into genuine love. However, a rift develops between them due to the presence of Phawin's 'first love,' who Thanwa unbeknownst to him as his own. Little does Thanwa know that he himself has actually been Phawin's first love all along.

series.name: Built in Love
series.original_name: ก่อร่างสร้างเลิฟ
series.overview: Soul is a skilled architect. Xinxin is a successful Feng Shui master. When these two women with polar opposite personalities are hired to build a house together for its homeowners, a battle between them ensues. But will there be space for love to bloom?

series.name: Love in the Countryside
series.original_name: หอมรักบ้านทุ่ง
series.overview: When the buffalo contest takes an unexpectedly chaotic turn, get ready for the mission to bring 'Homthong,' the champion giant buffalo, back to the care of his mother, 'Homngern.'

series.name: Love on Hire
series.original_name: รับจ้างเลิกรัก
series.overview: Thitinan will take any job—being a fake girlfriend and breaking up a relationship, or, special just for Miss Chat, becoming a bedroom coach.Adapted from the novel "Love on Hire" (รับจ้าง(เลิก)รัก) by Yuufuku

series.name: Motherland
series.original_name: เก็บแผ่นดิน
series.overview: Chulachart, a dedicated military officer, fights against the drug trade threatening his country, while Mintada, a warrior from the Kase tribe, falls in love with Punpasa across the border. As their lives become intertwined, they face a conflict that tests their love, sacrifice, and loyalty to their homeland.

series.name: The Hidden Shadows
series.original_name: แรงเงา
series.overview: After finding her twin sister Mutta’s body, Munin assumes her identity to uncover the truth behind her death and seek revenge. She targets powerful minister Nopnopha and her family, causing scandals that destroy careers and relationships.

series.name: My Sweetheart
series.original_name: แม่จอมขวัญ
series.overview: When a kind-hearted man impersonates his critically injured twin brother, a powerful crime boss, to uncover the truth behind an attack, he joins forces with a fearless young woman fighting to protect her village.
